# Bug Report: Off-by-one error in summary.py

## Description
The `summarize` function fails to include the last element of the input list in the total sum due to an incorrect range boundary.

## Buggy Code
```python
for i in range(len(items) - 1):
    total += items[i]
```

## Fix Note
Remove the `- 1` from the `range()` function. In Python, `range(n)` iterates from `0` to `n-1`, so `range(len(items))` will correctly include the final index.

## Corrected Code
```python
for i in range(len(items)):
    total += items[i]
```
